auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Pod AI API key sent with the X-Api-Key header. Create or manage keys from Settings > API Keys in the Pod dashboard: https://www.callpod.ai/docs/api-reference/authentication.

actions.name: create_outbound_call
actions.description: Create an outbound phone call with a Pod AI voice agent.

target_phone_number.description: The destination phone number to call, formatted as E.164.

from_phone_number.description: The Pod AI phone number to call from, formatted as E.164.

agent_id.description: The Pod AI agent identifier that should make the call.

additionalProperties.description: A metadata value passed to the Pod AI API.

metadata.description: Additional metadata forwarded to the Pod AI agent for the outbound call.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Pod AI outbound call.

call.description: The outbound call object returned by the Pod AI API.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for creating a Pod AI outbound call.
